chapter.title: Mekanism
chapter.subtitle: Industrial power, ore processing, and energy

quests.title: Heat Generator
quests.subtitle: Your first power source
description: Every machine needs power. A Heat Generator turns lava or burnable fuel into Forge Energy (FE) — the universal power unit.
Sit it in a pool of lava for free, passive power. Next: use that FE to run a Metallurgic Infuser.

quests.title: Metallurgic Infuser
quests.subtitle: Make Enriched Alloy
description: The Infuser fuses materials with 'infuse types' — redstone, carbon, diamond. Infuse iron with redstone to make Enriched Alloy.
Enriched Alloy is the building block of every Mekanism machine. Next: craft an Enrichment Chamber with it.

quests.title: Enrichment Chamber
quests.subtitle: First ore-processing machine
description: Your first ore-processing machine. It grinds 1 ore into 2 dust, ready for smelting.
Next: an Energized Smelter turns that dust into ingots.

quests.title: Energized Smelter
quests.subtitle: Smelt dust into ingots
description: Smelts dust into ingots using FE instead of coal. Feed it the Enrichment Chamber's dust and you've doubled your ore.
Next: run one ore through both machines to confirm the 2x chain.

quests.title: Double Your First Ore
quests.subtitle: Confirm the 2x chain works
description: Run one iron ore through Chamber -> Smelter and confirm you get 2 ingots from 1 ore.
This 2x chain is the foundation — Mekanism scales it to 3x and 5x later. Next: store the FE you're generating.

quests.title: Basic Energy Cube
quests.subtitle: Store your FE
description: Generators make FE constantly; machines use it in bursts. An Energy Cube smooths that out — the Basic Cube holds 1.6 million FE.
Next: take that FE with you in an Energy Tablet.

quests.title: Energy Tablet
quests.subtitle: Carry FE in your pocket
description: An Energy Tablet stores FE in your inventory. Charge it, then right-click a machine to power it without cables.
Next: a Chargepad to recharge it hands-free.

quests.title: Chargepad
quests.subtitle: Recharge by standing on it
description: A Chargepad recharges FE items you stand on it with. Drop your Tablet on it, wait, and pick it back up full.
Next: the ultimate all-in-one tool — the Atomic Disassembler.

quests.title: Atomic Disassembler
quests.subtitle: The all-in-one tool
description: One tool to replace pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe, sword, and shears. Modes for speed, precision, and vein mining — it runs on FE.
Keep it charged. This completes Phase 1 — next: scale ore processing to 3x.

quests.title: Steel Casing
quests.subtitle: Structural part of mid-tier machines
description: Most mid-tier machines need steel casings. Craft a stack early — you'll use them constantly.

quests.title: Configurator
quests.subtitle: The Mekanism wrench
description: Shift-right-click to pick up machines. Right-click to set which side takes input, which outputs.

quests.title: Gas-Burning Generator
quests.subtitle: Efficient ethylene power
description: Burns ethylene for lots of FE. More efficient than Heat Generators, but needs Phase 2 chemistry.

quests.title: Teleporter
quests.subtitle: Cross-base fast travel
description: Set a frequency, link two pads, and teleport between them. Costs FE per trip.

quests.title: Machine Upgrades
quests.subtitle: Speed vs. energy
description: Speed upgrades (red) = faster. Energy upgrades (green) = cheaper. Install them in a machine's upgrade slots.

quests.title: Tiered Factories
quests.subtitle: Basic to Ultimate
description: Machines upgrade Basic -> Advanced -> Elite -> Ultimate. An Ultimate Enrichment Chamber runs 7 items at once.

quests.title: Atmospheric Suit
quests.subtitle: Underwater breathing
description: Scuba Mask + Scuba Tank = underwater breathing. Free Runners add step-assist and fall protection. Craft before exploring oceans.

quests.title: Osmium Gear
quests.subtitle: Better than iron
description: Osmium gear beats iron. Progression: Osmium -> Bronze -> Refined Obsidian -> MekaSuit. Apotheosis affixes apply to it.

quests.title: Purification Chamber
quests.subtitle: Start of 3x processing
description: The Purification Chamber starts 3x ore processing. Chain: Purification -> Crusher -> Enrichment -> Smelter for 3 ingots from 1 ore.
It needs oxygen gas. Next: a Thermal Evaporation Plant to make the brine that starts Mekanism chemistry.

quests.title: Thermal Evaporation Plant
quests.subtitle: Water into brine
description: A multiblock that evaporates water into brine. Build it in a hot biome (desert heat is free) or heat it with a Resistive Heater.
Brine splits into chlorine + sodium. Next: an Electrolytic Separator to split water into hydrogen + oxygen.

quests.title: Electrolytic Separator
quests.subtitle: Split water into gases
description: Splits water into hydrogen + oxygen. Oxygen feeds the Purification Chamber; hydrogen feeds chemistry.
Next: a Chemical Infuser to combine gases into new ones.

quests.title: Chemical Infuser
quests.subtitle: Combine gases
description: Combines two gases into a new one. Hydrogen + chlorine = hydrogen chloride (HCl).
Next: a Chemical Injection Chamber to inject acid into ore.

quests.title: Chemical Injection Chamber
quests.subtitle: Acid for 4x processing
description: Injects acid into ore for 4x processing. HCl + ore = 4 ingots.
Next: the Chemical Dissolution Chamber — the start of full 5x processing.

quests.title: Chemical Dissolution Chamber
quests.subtitle: Dissolve ore in acid
description: Dissolves ore in sulfuric acid — the first step of 5x processing.
Next: a Chemical Washer to clean the dissolved slurry.

quests.title: Chemical Washer
quests.subtitle: Clean the slurry
description: Washes dissolved ore slurry into clean crystals.
Next: a Chemical Crystallizer to turn the slurry into ore crystals.

quests.title: Chemical Crystallizer
quests.subtitle: Crystallize the slurry
description: Crystallizes the slurry into ore crystals — the final chemical step before smelting.
Next: run the full chain to confirm 5x processing.

quests.title: Five-Times Ore Processing
quests.subtitle: Confirm the full 5x chain
description: Run one ore through the full chain: Dissolution -> Washer -> Crystallizer -> Injection -> Purification -> Crusher -> Enrichment -> Smelter.
1 ore -> 5 ingots. Next: a Digital Miner to automate the ore supply.

quests.title: Digital Miner
quests.subtitle: Automated mining
description: Set a filter (ores*), power it, and it teleport-mines directly into its own inventory. Manual mining is over.
Next: a Pressurized Reaction Chamber for ethylene and plastic.

quests.title: Pressurized Reaction Chamber
quests.subtitle: Gases, fluids, and solids
description: Combines gases, fluids, and solids in one machine. Key recipe: ethylene (for gas generators) + HDPE plastic.
Next: an Induction Matrix for massive FE storage.

quests.title: Induction Matrix
quests.subtitle: Billions of FE
description: Giant FE storage. Multiblock of Induction Casings filled with Cells (capacity) and Providers (transfer rate).
Next: Seismic Surveying to map the underground before you dig.

quests.title: Seismic Surveying
quests.subtitle: Map the underground
description: A Vibrator sends waves underground; a Reader reveals caves, lava, and ore veins. Find dense ore clusters for your Digital Miner.
Next: the Fission Reactor — Mekanism's nuclear power.

quests.title: Fission Reactor
quests.subtitle: Nuclear power
description: Nuclear power at 7 MFE/t. Multiblock: Frame + Controller + Fuel Assembly + Control Rods. Needs coolant and careful rod settings — a meltdown is possible, so build it away from your base.
It produces nuclear waste (store it safely). Next: the Fusion Reactor for zero-waste power.

quests.title: Boiler
quests.subtitle: Fission heat to steam
description: Converts fission heat into steam, which feeds an Industrial Turbine for more FE. A bigger boiler makes more steam.

quests.title: Radiation Safety
quests.subtitle: Handle nuclear waste carefully
description: Nuclear waste is radioactive — it damages you and mutates mobs. Store it in waste barrels and never break them. Process it to Polonium with sunlight.

quests.title: Chemical Processing Map
quests.subtitle: Plan the whole flowchart
description: Map it before you build: water -> H2 + O2, H2 + Cl2 -> HCl -> injection, sulfur -> SO2 -> SO3 -> dissolution. Label your pipes.

quests.title: Robit
quests.subtitle: Your robot companion
description: A robot buddy: follows you, holds items, has a crafting table, and recharges your FE gear.

quests.title: Fusion Reactor
quests.subtitle: Zero-waste power
description: 200 MFE/t, zero waste. Laser-initiated D-T fusion needs a big laser array plus deuterium + tritium production.
Next: a Quantum Entangloporter for instant wireless transport.

quests.title: Quantum Entangloporter
quests.subtitle: Instant wireless transport
description: Instant wireless items, fluids, gases, and FE across any dimension. Set the same frequency on two Entangloporters and they connect.
Next: the SPS and MekaSuit — the endgame.

quests.title: SPS & MekaSuit
quests.subtitle: Become a demigod
description: The Supercritical Phase Shifter turns Polonium into Antimatter, which crafts the MekaSuit. Install the Gravitational Modulating Unit for creative flight, plus energy shield and jetpack modules.
You are a demigod.

quests.title: Polonium Production
quests.subtitle: Waste into fuel
description: Nuclear waste -> Solar Neutron Activator (needs sunlight) -> Polonium. Build several activators and chunk-load the area.

quests.title: Antimatter Chain
quests.subtitle: The full endgame chain
description: Uranium ore -> fissile fuel -> reactor -> waste -> polonium -> SPS -> antimatter. One pellet is hours of processing.
